title: 819. Shortest Distance to a Character

examples.explanation: Each position reports how far it is from the nearest e.
Distances shrink as the scan nears the final b.
The first cell holds the target itself.

hints: Adaptation: the target character is passed as a one-letter string; use its first character.
Sweep left to right tracking the last seen target, then right to left tracking the next one, keeping the closer of the two.
